title: On Bitopological Lie Algebroids
content: We introduce a framework for studying Lie algebroids on manifolds equipped with two topologies. The underlying smooth manifold is assumed to carry two topologies compatible with the same smooth structure, while the Lie algebroid data may be considered simultane- ously with respect to these topologies. We dene bitopological Lie algebroids as pairs of Lie algebroid structures over a common smooth base and investigate their anchors, brackets, morphisms, and cohomology. We dis- tinguish the case of two independent Lie algebroid structures from the stronger situation in which the two structures are identied by a vector bundle isomorphism. Examples involv- ing tangent Lie algebroids, action Lie algebroids, and cotangent Lie algebroids of Poisson manifolds are discussed. We also formulate compatibility conditions for pairs of Lie algebroid structures and establish elementary results concerning their sections and cohomology. The framework pro- vides a basis for further investigations of bitopological Lie groupoids, Lie bialgebroids, and geometric structures dened by two interacting dierential systems.
